reason: Both conversations are word-for-word identical, so there is no basis to prefer one over the other. Each correctly states the TV is out of scope, points to the manufacturer's support line or a specialist electronics repairer, and warns the homeowner not to open the case due to stored charge in the power supply. Neither clarifies whether there is sound or any smell, and neither offers the optional non-invasive checks (input/power reset/torch test), but these omissions apply equally to both.
